sights.w: NASA's visitor centre: Space Shuttle Atlantis, the Saturn V in the Apollo/Saturn V Center, rocket garden, launch simulator and bus tours past the launch pads.
sights.k: nasa space rocket shuttle apollo icon

sights.address: Kennedy Space Center, Merritt Island, FL
sights.w: Built to stack the Saturn V; one of the largest buildings by volume in the world and seen on the KSC bus tour.

sights.n: Merritt Island National Wildlife Refuge (Black Point Wildlife Drive)
sights.w: Refuge sharing land with KSC — 330 bird species; the 7-mile Black Point Wildlife Drive is the easy way to see wading birds, raptors and alligators.
24 miles of undeveloped Atlantic shoreline beside the launch pads; Playalinda Beach is the southern end.

sights.address: Space Coast Regional Airport, Titusville, FL
sights.w: Flying-warbird museum founded 1977 with 50+ historic aircraft.

sights.n: American Space Museum & Space Walk of Fame
sights.w: Volunteer-run museum founded 2001: firing-room consoles from Columbia's launch, Apollo and shuttle training suits, a women-astronauts exhibit.
800-ft pier on the closest beach to Orlando — the Space Coast's surf hub.
